acquisition: Programmatically read official EIA HTML history tables using the connected web reader. Saved year-month rows retain every 2020–2025 observation. Raw HTML was not available in this execution environment; these text snapshots are explicitly labeled extracted tables. acquire.py can refresh directly from official HTML when network access is available.
units: Nominal U.S. dollars per U.S. gallon, including taxes; regular gasoline, all formulations
notes: These are weekly Monday price observations, not weekly transaction-level averages.
All weekly observations receive equal weight in this post's period averages.
